question: The curved surface area of a sphere is 1386 cm². Find the volume of the sphere. [Use pi=(22)/(7)]
solution:
**Given:**

The curved surface area of a sphere = 1386 cm²

**Formula used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a sphere = 4πr²

Volume (V) of a sphere = (4/3)πr³

**Calculation:**

4πr² = 1386

⇒ r² = 1386 / (4 × (22/7))

⇒ r² = 1386 × 7 / 88

⇒ r² = 110.25

⇒ r = 10.5 cm

Volume (V) = (4/3)πr³

⇒ V = (4/3) × (22/7) × (10.5)³

⇒ V = (4/3) × (22/7) × 1157.625

⇒ V = 101,871 / 21

⇒ V = 4851 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**
